annotations.title: Critical Path Method (CPM) DAG & Resource Constraint Scheduler

description: Solves a task dependency DAG via the Critical Path Method (CPM) to compute ES/EF/LS/LF, Total Float/Slack, optimal makespan, and the Critical Path. Use when scheduling dependent engineering milestones or workflow steps to find the minimum project duration and zero-slack bottleneck path; for detecting circular code imports and file blast radius without task durations, use audit_module_dependency_cycles instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'tasks_json' ('time_unit' defaults to 'minutes'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

tasks_json.description: JSON string or array of tasks '[{"id":"t1","duration":3,"dependencies":[]}]' to schedule.

time_unit.description: Duration unit label attached to the schedule; defaults to 'hours' when omitted.

name: schedule_critical_path_tasks

critical_path.description: Ordered task IDs with zero slack that determine the overall project duration.

optimal_makespan_duration.description: Minimum total duration required to complete all tasks.

task_schedule.description: Per-task earliest_start, earliest_finish, latest_start, latest_finish, and total_float_slack.
